name: Recessed LED Downlight 6W - 9W - 12W - LUMIS - Bridgelux Chip - UGR11 - 3CCT - CRI +92 - Interchangeable Front
short_description:
Lumis LED Downlight offers selectable power 6W, 9W and 12W, with Bridgelux Chip 130Lm/W for exceptional efficiency. Its 3CCT technology (3000K - 4000K - 5700K) allows adjusting color temperature. With UGR11 to minimize glare and CRI+92 for impeccable color reproduction.

Its 24º beam angle directs light with precision, while its Selectable front ring (White, White Rombus, Matte Black, Mercury Black) adapts to any decorative style.
description:
LED Recessed Downlight 6W - 9W - 12W - LUMIS - Bridgelux Chip - UGR11 - 3CCT - CRI +92 - Interchangeable Front

The Lumis LED Downlight is an innovative and efficient lighting solution, designed to deliver versatility, performance and elegance in any type of space. Its modern, functional design makes it the ideal choice for residential, commercial and office applications, providing high-quality lighting with reduced energy consumption.

This downlight offers a selectable power of 6W, 9W and 12W, allowing the lighting level to be adjusted to the specific needs of the space. It incorporates a Bridgelux Chip of 130 Lm/W, which guarantees exceptional luminous efficiency, achieving intense, uniform lighting with low energy consumption. Thanks to this technology, it delivers performance equivalent to traditional luminaires of higher wattage, which translates into significant savings on the electricity bill and lower heat emission.

For a perfect fit in different environments, the Lumis LED Downlight integrates 3CCT technology, allowing you to select between three colour temperatures.

One of the most notable aspects of the Lumis LED Downlight is its ability to provide comfortable, glare-free lighting. Thanks to its low glare index (UGR < 11), this luminaire reduces visual fatigue and improves the lighting experience, making it ideal for spaces where concentration and visual comfort are essential.

In addition, its high colour rendering index (CRI > 92) guarantees an accurate, natural representation of colours, making it an excellent option for shops, art galleries, offices and any environment where colour fidelity is key.

Elegant and Customisable Design

For greater integration with any type of décor, this model incorporates an interchangeable front ring, allowing you to choose between the following options:

  • Basic White Front (DIE-CAST RING): Manufactured from aluminium using a die-casting process. For a clean, minimalist finish, ideal for modern, understated environments.
  • Rhombus White Front (RHOMBUS RING): With a rhombus-shaped design or rhomboid pattern texture that adds a distinctive, sophisticated touch.
  • Matt Black Front: Perfect for contemporary, elegant décor, creating a subtle and attractive contrast.
  • Mercury Black Front: With a metallic finish that adds an air of exclusivity and luxury to any space.

  • Supplied as standard with the Basic White Front (DIE-CAST RING).

This modular and customisable system allows the downlight to adapt to different decorative styles without having to replace the entire luminaire.

High-Quality Materials and Durability

Manufactured from premium aluminium, the Lumis White LED Downlight guarantees excellent heat dissipation, which extends its service life and maintains optimal performance over time. Its robust structure and efficient design ensure simple installation and long durability, reducing maintenance costs.

Recommended Applications and Uses

Thanks to its advanced features, the Lumis LED Downlight is ideal for a wide variety of spaces, including:

  • Homes: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and hallways.
  • Offices and workspaces: Reception areas, meeting rooms and workstations.
  • Shops and retail: Boutiques, supermarkets and shopping centres.
  • Hospitals and clinics: Consultation areas, corridors and waiting rooms.
  • Restaurants and hotels: Dining areas, bars and lobbies.
  • Galleries and museums: Art exhibitions and cultural spaces.
